name: MediaQueryVisibility
description: Shows one child while the viewport width is inside a range and another when it is not.

fields.minWidth: double? - narrowest inclusive width that shows the child
fields.maxWidth: double? - widest inclusive width that shows the child

notes: The component is width-only (the old one read MediaQueryData.size.width as well); a height bound would need its own component.
No token values in the theme: breakpoints are numbers, not design tokens, so the defaults are empty and the widget arguments stay primary.
